content: Check-in 15:00-22:00, check-out by 11:00. 入住 15:00-22:00，退房 11:00 前。Arriving after 22:00 must be arranged by phone first. 22:00 後抵達請先來電。
No. 88, Cijin 3rd Road, Cijin District, Kaohsiung (5 minutes on foot from Cijin Ferry Pier). 高雄市旗津區旗津三路 88 號（旗津渡輪站步行 5 分鐘）。
Take the ferry from Gushan Ferry Pier to Cijin (about 10 minutes, NT$30 one way), or take MRT to Sizihwan Station and walk 10 minutes to Gushan Pier. 搭捷運到西子灣站，步行 10 分鐘到鼓山渡輪站，搭渡輪約 10 分鐘（單程 NT$30）。
No private parking lot. Cars can use the public Cijin Parking Lot 300 m away (NT$30 per hour). Scooters can park free in front of the guesthouse. 無自有停車場；汽車可停 300 公尺外的旗津公有停車場（每小時 NT$30），機車可免費停在門口。
Breakfast is served 07:30-09:30 in the lobby. It is not included in the room price: NT$180 per person, order it the day before. 早餐 07:30-09:30，房價不含早餐，每人 NT$180，需前一天預訂。
Cash, credit card (Visa, Master, JCB), LINE Pay and bank transfer. 現金、信用卡（Visa、Master、JCB）、LINE Pay、銀行轉帳。
A 30% deposit by bank transfer within 3 days after booking; the rest is paid at check-in. 訂房後 3 天內匯 30% 訂金，餘款入住時付清。

Free cancellation 7 or more days before check-in. 3-6 days before: 50% of the deposit is kept. Less than 3 days: the deposit is not returned. Typhoon days: free change of date. 入住前 7 天以上免費取消；3-6 天收取 50% 訂金；3 天內訂金不退；颱風停班停課可免費改期。
Small dogs and cats (under 10 kg) are welcome in the Standard Double and Twin Room only, with a NT$400 pet cleaning fee per stay. 10 公斤以下小型犬貓可入住標準雙人房與雙床房，每次住宿加收寵物清潔費 NT$400。
Free Wi-Fi in every room. Network: Cijin_Seaview, the password is on the card in your room. 全館免費 Wi-Fi，名稱 Cijin_Seaview，密碼在房內卡片上。
Quiet hours 22:00-07:00. No smoking inside the building; smoking is allowed on the 1st-floor terrace. 22:00-07:00 為安靜時間；室內全面禁菸，可在一樓露台吸菸。
Stays of 3 nights or more: 10% off the room price. Friday and Saturday nights cost 20% more than weekdays. 連住 3 晚以上房價 9 折；週五、週六晚上房價加 20%。

Shared kitchen, rooftop terrace with sea view, coin laundry (NT$50 wash, NT$50 dry), luggage storage on the check-in and check-out day. Facilities that are not in this list are not confirmed: ask the front desk. 共用廚房、海景頂樓露台、投幣洗衣（洗 NT$50、烘 NT$50）、入住及退房當日可寄放行李。未列出的設施請洽櫃台確認。
Front desk phone 07-571-8888 (09:00-21:00), LINE ID @cijinseaview. 櫃台電話 07-571-8888（09:00-21:00），LINE ID @cijinseaview。
